info.description: Everything this computer can do by itself, the same calls on every computer: run commands, read, write, edit and search files, send web requests, keep text, and, where it has a screen, see and use its windows, mouse and keyboard. /onsay takes prompts from anyone with its prompt key, each answered by Onsay, and its calls answer this account's own devices and anyone with that key.

settings.name: token
settings.title: Sign in
settings.about: This computer's sign in to Onsay, kept by onsay-core <settings> call onsay.sign_in or by the Onsay app.

settings.name: prompt_key
settings.title: Prompt key
settings.about: What a program sends as Authorization: Bearer <prompt key> to prompt this computer at /onsay. Made on its first start.
